row: 教會山高 463 公尺，位於冰島斯奈山半島北岸、格倫達菲厄澤小鎮旁，是冰原島峰，號稱冰島被拍得最多的山；南邊有教會山瀑布。

airspace.zh: 本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍；在冰島飛行空拍機，請先確認當地規定與自然保護限制。
airspace.en: This film is simulated, not real drone footage. Check Iceland's drone rules and nature-protection limits before flying.

grundar.note: the town east of the mountain

title.zh-Hant: 教會山：三月夜空的極光
title.en: Kirkjufell: the aurora on a March night

tagline.zh-Hant: 冰島的教會山與瀑布，北方的夜空亮起極光
tagline.en: Iceland's Church Mountain and its waterfall under the northern lights

zh: 冰島斯奈山半島北岸的「教會山」。
三月中旬的傍晚，天空晴朗無雲。
en: Kirkjufell, 'Church Mountain', on the north coast of Iceland's Snæfellsnes peninsula.
A clear evening in mid-March.

zh: 它高 463 公尺，
號稱是冰島被拍得最多的一座山。
en: It stands 463 m high,
and is said to be the most photographed mountain in Iceland.

zh: 山的南邊，是小小的教會山瀑布；
從瀑布這邊看，山就在北方。
en: To the south lies the little Kirkjufellsfoss waterfall;
from the falls, the mountain stands to the north.

zh: 它不是火山，而是一座「冰原島峰」：
冰河時期，它的山頂一直露在冰層之上。
en: It is not a volcano but a nunatak:
during the Ice Age its top stood above the surrounding glaciers.

zh: 山體由一層層更新世的熔岩與砂岩堆成，
山頂是凝灰岩。
en: It is built of alternating layers of Pleistocene lava and sandstone,
with tuff at its summit.

zh: 入夜後，北方的天空亮起一道綠光：
極光出現了。
en: After dark a band of green light rises in the northern sky:
the aurora is here.

zh: 太陽風擾動了地球的磁場，
帶電粒子撞上高空的氧與氮，發出綠、紅與紫色的光。
en: Disturbances in the solar wind shake Earth's magnetic field;
charged particles strike oxygen and nitrogen high above, glowing green, red and purple.

zh: 極光最常出現在「極光帶」：
以北緯 67 度為中心、寬約 6 度的一圈。
en: Auroras are seen most often in the "auroral zone",
a band about 6° wide centred on 67° north.

zh: 這裡大約在北緯 65 度；
地磁擾動變強時，極光帶會往南擴大。
en: Here we are at about 65° north;
a geomagnetic storm pushes the auroral zone further south.

zh: 東邊的小鎮格倫達菲厄澤；
這一帶鯡魚多，斯奈山半島是冰島常能看到虎鯨的地方。
en: East of the mountain lies the town of Grundarfjörður;
with plenty of herring, Snæfellsnes is where orcas are regularly seen in Iceland.

zh: 夏天與秋天可以攀登，約需三小時；
但陡坡在潮濕或天氣差時很危險。
en: It can be climbed in summer and autumn, in about three hours,
but the steep sections are dangerous when wet or in bad weather.

zh: 本片為擬真畫面：地形與衛星影像為真實資料，
極光為模擬，不代表當晚實際的天象。
en: Simulated: the terrain and satellite imagery are real data;
the aurora is simulated and does not show the real sky that night.
